subject: Quick integration walkthrough — scheduling options inside
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Choi <alex.choi@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2029-06-17T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — next steps and a short walkthrough

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up and starting the trial — welcome aboard. A couple quick things to make our first call high value:

- We’ll keep it to 30 minutes focused on getting a dev-friendly walk of the integration and sample latency/cost expectations for your workload.
- If you have a particular dataset or prompt set you want us to run, paste a link to a sample (private link is fine).

Pick a slot that works for you: https://redwood.ai/schedule/jasmine-30m

Attached is a short Getting Started checklist that walks through API keys, example requests, and common troubleshooting items.

If you'd prefer, our SDR will coordinate a specific time and loop in the right solutions engineer.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0176

Attachments:
- redwood-getting-started-checklist.pdf (PDF, 38 KB)

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the quick follow. I registered via the self-serve flow this morning.

A couple constraints on our side:
- Timezone: PST (San Francisco).
- Prefer afternoons (1pm–4pm) next week.
- Would be great if an engineering-focused person can join to talk about model pinning and private deployments.

I tried the link but the calendar showed limited availability. If it's easier, could your SDR propose 2–3 windows?

Thanks,
